judul: Seijo no Maryoku wa Bannou desu
author: TACHIBANA Yuka (II)
synopsis: Sei, a 20 year old office worker, is summoned to a different world after finishing some overtime work. But the person who had summoned her looks at her face and said, “This is not the Saint.” Instead, the other summoned lady is lauded as the Saint, while Sei is ignored.
